panel-1.notes: Panel needs `yoy` and optional `mom3_ar` (3-month annualized). Y/Y is in processed/; 3M-AR derives from the raw level via annualize_period_growth(period_lag=3, periods_per_year=12).

panel-3.notes: Boc-tracker breadth recipe ported into pipeline.build.derive_cpi_breadth_band(). Two monthly time series (above3, below1) plus a scalar metadata payload carrying the 1996-2019 historical averages for reference bands on the chart. Weights from data/derived/cpi_component_weights_canada.json; per-component levels from data/raw/cpi_components.csv (must be force-added to git for CI deploys).

metadata.name: cpi_breadth_band_metadata
metadata.notes: Boc-tracker port (analyze.py 2026-05-11 vintage). Components kept = 59 (those with first_valid_index <= 1995-01-01, intersected with cpi_component_weights_canada.json). Weights renormalised over the kept set; original weight sum was 96.09 of 100. Monthly rows dropped when any kept component is missing its 12-mo prior observation (the all-valid mask). Historical reference: 1996-2019 averages are 26.72% (above3) and 40.93% (below1).

panel-4.notes: Shelter decomposition (exMIC vs MIC) needs cpi_rented_accommodation_yoy + cpi_mortgage_interest_yoy; both on disk.
